label: Paul Barry (Football DNA)
name: Football DNA
bio: Before Football DNA, Paul coached in the academy system at Southend United, Watford and Arsenal, most recently as Crystal Palace's Head of Coaching for the Foundation Phase.

label: Martin Brock (JPL)
name: Junior Premier League
bio: Martin is Chief Executive of the Junior Premier League, one of the largest competitive youth football organisations in the UK, alongside its girls' league, JPL Warriors.

label: Matt Baxter (Elite Mindset Coach)
name: Elite Mindset Coach
bio: Matt works one to one with young athletes aged 8 to 18, from grassroots to academy and national level, on confidence, handling mistakes and performing under pressure.

label: Girls United team
name: Girls United
bio: Girls United runs girls' football clubs and sessions in London and Mexico, including Play Like a Girl in South London, where girls can start even if they've never played or don't know anyone.
